Orphan, Wrapper, Node, Holder, Mix, Link and ms are not reached from Shape and have no declaration witness; they are neither required nor inspected.

note: QSL-2743. Row-contract vectors for FR-830 (selected model-union and model-tuple witness rows). INPUTS. Each case names a fixture pair of `fixtures` (A, B or C): a complete FCD selected document (`document`) and a complete checked package (`package`); a positive's `document_patch` is a JSON Patch over that document's real members (`/types/N/variants/...`), never over a projection. Fixture B is an additive completion of A and fixture C adds the source union Route to B: domain-package-acme-shapes-witness.json adds the record construct, the dimension Time, the unit ms, the records Wrapper, Node and Orphan and the unions Link and Mix to domain-package-acme-shapes.json, and fixtures/witness-model-union-rows.json adds the matching model nodes (object_type Holder, three record_value_type, two variant_type, the dimension and the unit node, each a model-owned node with the empty aggregate body, one generated occurrence and no declaration, as in the existing model-owned timed fixtures), each with its source_map entry and its empty operand_rows entry, before the model_root. The sidecar of a case is the object `{model_tuples, model_unions}` (plus the existing `source_unions` member where a case names it) and its `witnesses.declarations` rows; a refusal `expected` carries `code`, the list or member `locus` pointer and, where the refusal is an absent needed row, the structural `node` of the node that needs it; these are the whole input beside the package, the document and the lock, so no tuple, record, object or unit witness is held in memory by the producer: every join runs from bytes. A refusal's `patch` is a JSON Patch over the sidecar object (pointers `/model_tuples/...` and `/model_unions/...`), its `witnesses_patch` one over `witnesses` (pointers `/declarations/...`), `scope_override` replaces the base's scope, and it inherits the base's fixtures, document_patch, scope, witnesses, model_tuples and model_unions. `file_members` names identity-file members present and unchanged that no check reads. ENCODINGS are the producer sidecar's existing ones written as JSON values: `structural_node` and each payload `node` are the serde form of CheckedNodeId, which is the `node_id` object of the node in the package; `type_handle`, `settled_key`, `node_key`, `member.declaration` and the composite and unit `node` of `original_type` are OriginalNodeKey values (nested at most 32 keys); `original_type` is a complete OriginalValueType (a reference carries `effective: {chain: [{package, node}]}`); `original_case` is the DeclarationKey {package, node} of the selected document's variant. The vectors are symbolic: node ids are written as the node ids of the packages and no vector derives an original key from a name. Declarations rows are written `{structural_node, selected_document, form, original_identity, exact_identity}` with `exact_identity` `{kind: record|object|declared_unit, value}`. Row order, scope and budget follow FR-830: the sidecar rows sort ascending by structural_node, a union's cases by UTF-8 byte order of name, and equal neighbouring structural_nodes are a duplicate (a conflict), not a disorder. The first refusal wins: each mutation is chosen so that no earlier check refuses first. A positive inherits nothing; a refusal inherits its base and a budget case builds its base with an ample budget. Budgets are baseline-relative (W, S, Wt, St are measured on the same input by the same budget), never static totals. Cases built from a `document_patch` were constructed over documents whose strict package read is consistent with the patched document (unused unions only). STATUS: no harness executes these vectors and nothing is qualified by them. The packages and documents are inputs, not results of any reader.
